# A CAD book whose income and expenses are all in US dollars, and which holds
# no USD price at all.
#
# GnuCash values what it cannot price at nothing, so the retained earnings
# convert to 0.00 CAD — while the book plainly has them: 500.00 USD of
# consulting against 100.00 USD of fees. The page states the key at 0.00 and
# the account lines at `value: "0.00"`, which together say "this money was
# valued at nothing". A key that vanished instead would say the book had no
# such earnings.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Consulting
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Fees
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-02-01 * "Consulting, in US dollars"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD Bank 500.00 USD
	Income:Consulting -500.00 USD

2026-03-01 * "Fees, in US dollars"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Fees 100.00 USD
	Assets:USD Bank -100.00 USD
